It omits the distinct KMS authorization context entirely. The graph already acknowledges this assumption through `separately supplied key authority` and `KMS authority distinct`; the semantic report fails to account for it.

Remove the unsupported mappings and resolve any genuinely required command-execution foundation within the existing concepts.
